train-a.intro: Use the supplied {domain} measurement and choose the matching rule.
train-a.mid: {field} is at least {lo} and less than {hi}.
train-a.symbolic_intro: Evaluate the {domain} rule expressions against the state.

train-b.intro: Classify the {domain} reading by the numerical conditions listed below.
train-b.mid: The value of {field} reaches {lo} but remains below {hi}.
train-b.high: The value of {field} reaches or exceeds {hi}.
train-b.ge: The value of {field} reaches or exceeds {cutoff}.

dev-a.intro: Assign this {domain} observation to its stated numerical category.
dev-a.low: For {field}, the required range ends strictly before {lo}.
dev-a.mid: For {field}, the range starts inclusively at {lo} and ends exclusively at {hi}.
dev-a.high: For {field}, the required range begins inclusively at {hi}.
dev-a.ge: For {field}, the range begins inclusively at {cutoff}.
dev-a.lt: For {field}, the range ends strictly before {cutoff}.
dev-a.symbolic_intro: Find the true predicate for this {domain} observation.

dev-b.intro: Resolve the {domain} decision using the comparison criteria.
dev-b.mid: Accept when {field} is not smaller than {lo} but is smaller than {hi}.
dev-b.high: Accept when {field} is not smaller than {hi}.
dev-b.ge: Accept when {field} is not smaller than {cutoff}.
dev-b.symbolic_intro: Resolve the {domain} decision by testing each expression.

calibration-a.intro: Determine which listed interval contains the {domain} measurement.
calibration-a.mid: {field} lies between included endpoint {lo} and excluded endpoint {hi}.
calibration-a.high: {field} belongs at or above the included endpoint {hi}.
calibration-a.ge: {field} belongs at or above the included endpoint {cutoff}.
calibration-a.symbolic_intro: Determine the matching formal guard for the {domain} value.

calibration-b.intro: Apply the specified numerical bands to this {domain} record.
calibration-b.mid: A {field} reading from {lo} inclusive to {hi} exclusive qualifies.
calibration-b.high: A {field} reading of {hi} or greater qualifies.
calibration-b.ge: A {field} reading of {cutoff} or greater qualifies.
calibration-b.symbolic_intro: Apply the listed comparison formulas to the {domain} record.

test-a.intro: Locate the {domain} input within the criteria-defined ranges.
test-a.low: The permitted {field} values are strictly lower than {lo}.
test-a.mid: The permitted {field} values include {lo} and extend up to, but not including, {hi}.
test-a.high: The permitted {field} values include {hi} and every greater value.
test-a.ge: The permitted {field} values include {cutoff} and every greater value.
test-a.lt: The permitted {field} values are strictly lower than {cutoff}.
test-a.symbolic_intro: Locate the satisfied logical test for the {domain} input.

test-b.intro: Match the {domain} quantity to the applicable comparison statement.
test-b.low: This statement holds only while {field} stays short of {lo}.
test-b.mid: This statement holds from {field} equal to {lo} until it reaches {hi}, which is excluded.
test-b.high: This statement holds once {field} meets the minimum {hi}.
test-b.ge: This statement holds once {field} meets the minimum {cutoff}.
test-b.lt: This statement holds only while {field} stays short of {cutoff}.
test-b.symbolic_intro: Match the {domain} quantity to a true formal statement.
